Dramatis Personæ

BASILIO, 
King of Poland.

his Son.

his Nephew.

FIFE,

CHAMBERLAIN, LORDS-IN-WAITING, OFFICERS, SOLDIERS, ETC., IN BASILIO’S SERVICE.
